column1: # Expected verdicts for verify-dream-state.py on the fixtures in this
# directory. Consumer: verify-dream-state.py --selftest, which runs every row.
# Each exit-1 fixture carries exactly one defect, so a row fails if the check
# that defect targets is removed (mutation-sensitive). Each exit-0 fixture
# other than v3-valid carries one edge case a regressed check would reject:
# cost_records out of date order (append order is authoritative), a populated
# quiet_sweeps, a kind-baseline cost record with null fields, a
# quiet_sweeps.projects key that is not (yet) a projects key, a
# tokens_by_role record whose stages sum exactly to surfaced - kept, a
# five-role tokens_by_role (with drafter) and a file mixing it with a
# legacy four-role record, a model_routing provider with the optional
# drafter and one without it, and
# kind-sweep records without tokens_by_role that break the findings
# invariants (exempt: written before the field existed). The
# top-level-array) guard the .ps1 twin's pipeline unrolling.
#   fixture        file name in this directory
#   exit           expected exit code (0 = valid, 1 = FAIL)
#                  or - for none (the ledger check then prints a skip note)
#   must_contain   substring the output must contain
